Author: Qmeko
Name: ConditionCommandSender
Punchline: Log-trigger rules with tags, commands, waits, and Lua. EN/JA UI.
Description: All collected logs are evaluated against every enabled rule. Rules are organized with tags. Flow steps are Wait, Command, and Lua. UI language follows Dalamud, or can be switched between English and Japanese in Settings.

Author: Qmeko
Name: MateriaExtractor
Punchline: Retrieve materia and meld from an exdreams share URL.
Description: CTRL+Right-click retrieves materia once (auto-accepts the confirm dialog). /mex parses an exdreams gear share URL for inventory check, dry-run, and auto-meld.

Author: XeldarAlz / debug fork
Name: Doman Mahjong Solver Debug
Punchline: Mortal / Akochan suggestions and auto-play. Mortal installs on first launch.
Description: Reads Doman Mahjong and uses Mortal or Akochan for discard, riichi, pass, chi, pon, kan, ron, and tsumo. Mortal is installed automatically on first launch. Akochan can run in realtime or precision mode.
